title: No Invisibility Particles
description: Remove the particles when using invisibility to be truly hidden.
body:
This datapack removes the particle effects when using any type of invisibility, including drinkable potions, splash potions, tipped arrows, and lingering potions.

wearing armor and running still makes particles so that invisibility isn't too overpowered.
when splashing invisibility on mobs, it also makes them completely invisible.

![With glowing and without the datapack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a168c4a5bd5661f92548347d13ac3fc78f3f5bb0_0.webp)![With glowing effect and the datapack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/46ad1c54f2b9b6d582b5e2681ebeb7093c25223f_0.webp)

Invisibility Particles NO MORE!
remove invisibility particles.
invisible particles.
invisibility particle remover.
this is also my first datapack ever!
